articles.title: Tiny Pond Creature Uses DNA Stop Signals in a Surprising New Way
articles.summary: Researchers found a pond protist that turns usual DNA stop signals into amino-acid codes, challenging long-held genetic rules.

articles.title: Homeowner Digging a Terrace Finds Record Viking Silver Hoard in Denmark
articles.summary: A Danish backyard dig for a terrace uncovered about 700 Viking Age silver objects—the largest silver hoard found in Denmark.

articles.title: Wavy Walls and Roofs May Soften Hurricane Wind Forces
articles.summary: Wind-tunnel tests show deeply wavy walls and roofs can cut peak hurricane wind pressure at corners by up to about 60 percent versus flat designs.
